terms.oneLiner: The 25x faster modern replacement for Redis — built for multi-core CPUs with 80% less memory overhead.
terms.notes: High on the VidiSmart Masterlist. Eliminates Redis single-thread bottlenecks for real-time agent swarm telemetry.
terms.origin: Oded Poncz & Roman Gershman (2022) · Next-Gen In-Memory Architecture

smartStack.label: Next-Gen Multi-Threaded Cache
smartStack.headline: In-Memory Caching is evolving from single-core Redis to multi-threaded Dragonfly
smartStack.description: Redis was designed 15 years ago for single-core servers. Dragonfly redesigns memory storage for modern 64-core AI hardware, delivering 4M+ queries/second on a single instance.

legacyStack.label: Single-threaded Redis core
legacyStack.note: Bottlenecks on 1 CPU core while 63 cores sit idle

legacyStack.label: Complex cluster sharding
legacyStack.note: Requires dozens of nodes, complex proxies, and sentinel scripts

legacyStack.label: OOM memory spikes
legacyStack.note: Can crash when taking background memory snapshots

newStack.label: Multi-threaded C++ engine
newStack.note: Runs simultaneously across every CPU core with zero lock contention

newStack.label: Single-node simplicity
newStack.note: Handles millions of operations on one server without cluster complexity

newStack.label: Smart memory compression
newStack.note: Stores up to 3x more data in the same RAM with zero snapshot crashes

anatomy.desc: Key-value records, token counters, and queue payloads stored directly in high-speed memory.
Harnesses every CPU thread simultaneously for 4M+ queries per second.
Custom shared-nothing thread architecture eliminating queue bottlenecks.

terms.notes: SaaS replaced buying software on discs. Smart Apps are now replacing the need to click through it manually.
terms.origin: Salesforce & SIIA (2000) · Evolving → AI-Enabled Smart Apps (2025+)

smartStack.label: AI-Enabled Smart Apps
smartStack.headline: SaaS is becoming the Smart Stack
smartStack.description: For 20 years SaaS meant: rent software, click through menus, repeat. The shift happening right now: you describe what you want in plain language and the Smart App handles every step. The technical part vanishes. What stays is your intention — and the outcome.

legacyStack.label: Click a menu to do a thing
legacyStack.note: 50 screens. Manual. Every step requires a trained human.

legacyStack.label: Per-seat licensing
legacyStack.note: You pay for access. Whether anyone uses it or not.

legacyStack.label: You are the workflow
legacyStack.note: If you stop clicking, nothing happens.

legacyStack.label: IT owns the update cycle
legacyStack.note: Quarterly patches. You wait. They schedule.

newStack.label: Describe what you want
newStack.note: Plain language. No training required. The Smart App understands intent.

newStack.label: Pay for the outcome
newStack.note: Value-based. You pay for what gets done, not who has a login.

newStack.label: Agents are the workflow
newStack.note: They plan, execute, verify, and report back. You review the result.

newStack.label: The app improves itself
newStack.note: Every run makes it smarter. No manual update cycle.

anatomy.desc: A program — now evolving from static screens you click to AI agents that work for you.
Delivered through the internet. You open a browser. It's there. No installation, no server room.
Like a subscription — Netflix for business software. Cancel anytime. No large upfront costs.
